ctx.x: She’s done a lot of research in Mississippi. As a matter of fact, she even dug up more about Hagar, who was my great-great grandmother. And Hagar was taken from her parents at ten years old in the South of Mississippi and taken up to Bolivar, Tennessee, sold into slavery, and I’ve never gotten over that.
